description.narrative: ​Contribute to the creation of cohesive societies in the MENA region that are characterized by cooperation between religious groups and understanding of ‘the religious other. Builds on the existing DAID-network that offers a great networking space to spread the needed values and connections across all religions in Lebanon and the MENA region. Focus on the need to sustain the networks by including women and the new generation of young religious actors so that they can become part of the existing network and making these networks open and active. The existing members will play the role of coaching to the new members in designing and implementing local initiatives in their communities. Furthermore; the project aims to spread the knowledge; experiences; testimonials; and wisdom of the members to the larger audience by investing in media channels and tools to reach the wider audience. Expectation is that these testimonials can be a source of inspiration for the current times and generation on dialogue and cooperation in times of crisis.
